title: Jaggedly Fermented Korean Samphire Bao
description: A unique Korean dish featuring fermented samphire, flaky bao dough, and a high-protein twist. Perfect for a date-night dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, coarse sea salt, and warm water to create a shaggy dough.
Add sourdough starter and mix until the dough comes together in a sticky ball.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it ferment at room temperature for 24 hours.
After 24 hours, punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of gochujang in the center of each circle, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top with samphire, brown sugar, sesame oil, green onions, and toasted sesame seeds.
Fold the dough over the filling to create a half-moon shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and cook the baos for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
